subject: [PATCH v4 1/2] mm/page_alloc: move the kswapd node skip check into a helper

reviews.author: Harry Yoo
reviews.summary: Approved the patch with a Reviewed-by tag. The code looks good to them.
reviews.raw_body:
On Mon, Nov 23, 2026 at 10:18:27AM -0800, Joshua Hahn wrote:
> get_page_from_freelist() checks many conditions for each zone, often
> with a big comment block explaining the conditions.
> 
> Move the kswapd check and its comment into should_skip_kswapd_zone() to
> make the zone iteration cleaner to read.
> 
> While moving this, also resolve a checkpatch warning which complains of
> a waitqueue_active() call with no corresponding comment explaining why
> the lockless use is OK in this case.
> 
> No functional change intended.
> 
> Reviewed-by: SJ Park <sj@kernel.org>
> Reviewed-by: Chris Down <chris@chrisdown.name>
> Reviewed-by: Zi Yan <ziy@nvidia.com>
> Reviewed-by: Gregory Price <gourry@gourry.net>
> Reviewed-by: Dev Jain <dev.jain@arm.com>
> Tested-by: Chris Down <chris@chrisdown.name>
> Signed-off-by: Joshua Hahn <joshua.hahnjy@gmail.com>
> ---

Looks good to me,
Reviewed-by: Harry Yoo (Meta) <harry@kernel.org>

-- 
Cheers,
Harry / Hyeonggon

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch refactors the kswapd node skip check in mm/page_alloc.c into a separate helper function, should_skip_kswapd_zone(). The original code had a big comment block explaining the conditions for each zone, which is now moved to the new helper. Additionally, a checkpatch warning about a waitqueue_active() call with no corresponding comment was resolved.
